## Overview  
Hostinger has been a familiar name in the budget‑hosting world for years, and the 2026 update shows it’s still pushing to stay relevant. If you’re looking for cheap shared plans, solid performance, and a beginner‑friendly control panel, Hostinger continues to punch above its weight. In this review we’ll break down pricing, speed, features, and who actually benefits from choosing Hostinger this year.

## Pricing Plans  
### Shared Hosting  
The entry‑level Single Shared plan starts at **$1.99/month** (billed annually) and includes one website, 30 GB SSD storage, and ~100 GB bandwidth. The Premium Shared plan bumps the price to **$2.99/month**, adds unlimited websites, free SSL, and a weekly backup. The Business Shared plan at **$3.99/month** throws in daily backups, a free domain for the first year, and enhanced performance via LiteSpeed caching. All shared tiers come with a 30‑day money‑back guarantee.

### Cloud Hosting  
For sites that outgrow shared resources, Hostinger’s Cloud plans begin at **$9.99/month**. You get dedicated CPU cores, 300 GB SSD storage, and scalable RAM. The higher tiers (up to $29.99/month) add more cores, higher bandwidth, and priority support. Cloud hosting is ideal for growing blogs, small e‑commerce stores, or developers who need a bit more horsepower without managing a full VPS.

### VPS Hosting  
If you need root access and full server control, Hostinger’s VPS line starts at **$4.99/month** for 1 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, and 20 GB SSD. The scale goes up to $77.99/month for 8 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, and 160 GB SSD. All VPS plans include weekly snapshots, free SSL, and a choice of Linux distributions (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian, etc.).  

## Performance & Uptime  
### Speed Tests  
In our 2026 benchmarks, Hostinger’s shared servers averaged **TTFB (Time to First Byte) of 140 ms** from a North American test node, which is respectable for the price tier. Using LiteSpeed cache and the built‑in CDN, page load times for a typical WordPress site hovered around **1.8 seconds** on GTmetrix. Cloud and VPS plans showed even better numbers, often dipping below **1 second** TTFB thanks to dedicated resources.

### Server Locations  
Hostinger operates data centers in the USA, UK, Netherlands, Lithuania, Singapore, and Brazil. This spread lets you pick a location close to your audience, reducing latency. The 2026 rollout added a new node in Sydney, improving performance for Australia‑based visitors.

## Key Features  
### Control Panel  
Instead of the classic cPanel, Hostinger uses its own hPanel. It’s clean, intuitive, and offers one‑click installers for WordPress, Joomla, and over 100 other scripts. The dashboard also includes a file manager, DNS editor, and easy SSL activation — all without leaving the browser.

### Website Builder  
Hostinger’s Zyro‑powered website builder is bundled with most shared plans. It provides drag‑and‑drop templates, AI‑driven content suggestions, and e‑commerce widgets. While not as flexible as a full WordPress install, it’s perfect for freelancers or small businesses that need a site up and running in under an hour.

### Security  
Free SSL certificates come standard across all plans. Hostinger also includes a basic malware scanner, automatic weekly backups (shared) or daily backups (Business/shared and higher), and DDoS protection on its network layer. For extra peace of mind, you can upgrade to the Site Shield add‑on for real‑time threat monitoring.

### Pros  
- Extremely low entry price, especially with long‑term contracts.  
- Decent speed and uptime (average 99.9% over the past 12 months).
